### YMCA turns crisis into capability at scale

YMCA partnered with Accenture to build a community-based model that helps refugees and displaced
people gain skills, find work, and rebuild their futures—moving from relief to long-term capability.

[
Read more
][135]

### How UNICEF's GenU is closing the youth skills gap

Through UNICEF’s partnership with Accenture, young people gain access to AI-powered skilling,
digital learning and entrepreneurship opportunities that connect them to employment and brighter
futures.

[
Read more
][136]

### Philipstown's wire cars go global

Philipstown’s wire car tradition is accelerating onto the global stage through immersive
storytelling, gaming and commerce—fueling opportunity and driving impact far beyond the track.

[
Read more
][137]

### Google Cloud reimagines lead enrichment with agentic AI

The leading hyperscaler replaced batch processing with an agentic model that delivers decision-ready
outputs up to 30x faster—sharpening prioritization while enabling more confident sales decisions.

[
Read more
][138]

### Bristol Myers Squibb scales AI to rewire everyday work

The life sciences leader is putting people at the center of its AI ambition—rewiring work across the
enterprise to empower employees, drive innovation and accelerate the delivery of therapies to
patients.

[
Read more
][139]

[Acronis]

## GenAI Protection

NEW

Businesses want the benefits of AI, but not the risk. They already use AI tools for research,
writing, coding, and customer communication but often without control or visibility. This creates
shadow AI, data exposure, and compliance gaps. Now MSPs can change that. Deliver secure AI
productivity as managed services, fully integrated into the platform you already operate, with
governance, visibility, and protection built in.

[Acronis]

## Detection and Response

Acronis EDR and XDR helps you protect clients against threats and comply with cyber insurance
requirements. With complete protection spanning the NIST framework, Acronis EDR and XDR enabling
MSPs with data governance / compliance and the ability to identify, protect, detect, respond and
recover from threats. In addition to EDR & XDR, Acronis also offers MDR so that MSPs can offer their
clients a fully managed service with minimal resource investment.

[Acronis]

## SaaS Security

Detect, block and remediate advanced email and cloud application threats with AI-powered solutions
that protect your clients from the #1 threat vector. Acronis Email Security (for Microsoft 365 and
Google Workspace) and Collaboration Security (for Microsoft 365) provides the ease of use that MSPs
need.

[Acronis]

## Backup

Protect clients’ data no matter where it might reside across physical, virtual and cloud-based
environments. Acronis backup protects more than 20 workload types from one console and features
file-level, disk-level, image and application backups, along with hybrid storage options,
incremental and differential backups, and more.

[Acronis]

## Disaster Recovery

Rapidly recover from ransomware, cyberthreats and other unplanned outages. Acronis Disaster Recovery
empowers MSPs to restore operations in just a few clicks and deliver disaster recovery services with
ease. With fast recovery, three-click setup and a single console, Acronis Disaster Recovery provides
a single solution for any workload.

[Acronis]

## HCI & IaaS

Deliver infrastructure services on your own terms with Acronis Cyber Frame — a secure hyperconverged
infrastructure (HCI) and infrastructure-as-a-service (IaaS) solution built specifically for service
providers. It enables you to provision and manage virtual machines, storage and networking with
built-in cyber protection, management and automation. Built on optimized OpenStack and the KVM
hypervisor, it supports multitenancy, white-label delivery and two deployment models: Acronis-hosted
and SP-hosted deployment.

[Acronis]

## RMM

Achieve peak MSP performance with a natively integrated, secure, AI-powered RMM that provides
seamless automation of IT management to boost technician performance. With Acronis RMM, MSPs can
deliver superior IT administration and monitoring services while improving security posture for both
endpoints and Microsoft 365.

[Acronis]

## PSA

Simplify success with an easy-to-deploy, adopt and use PSA tailored for modern recurring and cloud
MSP business models. Acronis PSA features service desk, billing and invoicing, contract and
quotation management, stock inventory and project management, and insightful KPI reports. Part of
Acronis Cyber Protect Cloud, Acronis PSA is natively integrated with Acronis RMM, cybersecurity and
data protection in a single console and offers comprehensive integrations with third-party RMM and
accounting systems.

NEW

Businesses want the benefits of AI, but not the risk. They already use AI tools for research,
writing, coding, and customer communication but often without control or visibility. This creates
shadow AI, data exposure, and compliance gaps. Now MSPs can change that. Deliver secure AI
productivity as managed services, fully integrated into the platform you already operate, with
governance, visibility, and protection built in.

[Acronis]

## Detection and Response

Acronis EDR and XDR helps you protect clients against threats and comply with cyber insurance
requirements. With complete protection spanning the NIST framework, Acronis EDR and XDR enabling
MSPs with data governance / compliance and the ability to identify, protect, detect, respond and
recover from threats. In addition to EDR & XDR, Acronis also offers MDR so that MSPs can offer their
clients a fully managed service with minimal resource investment.

[Acronis]

## SaaS Security

Detect, block and remediate advanced email and cloud application threats with AI-powered solutions
that protect your clients from the #1 threat vector. Acronis Email Security (for Microsoft 365 and

need.

Protect clients’ data no matter where it might reside across physical, virtual and cloud-based
environments. Acronis backup protects more than 20 workload types from one console and features
file-level, disk-level, image and application backups, along with hybrid storage options,
incremental and differential backups, and more.

a single solution for any workload.

Deliver infrastructure services on your own terms with Acronis Cyber Frame — a secure hyperconverged
infrastructure (HCI) and infrastructure-as-a-service (IaaS) solution built specifically for service
providers. It enables you to provision and manage virtual machines, storage and networking with
built-in cyber protection, management and automation. Built on optimized OpenStack and the KVM
hypervisor, it supports multitenancy, white-label delivery and two deployment models: Acronis-hosted
and SP-hosted deployment.

Achieve peak MSP performance with a natively integrated, secure, AI-powered RMM that provides
seamless automation of IT management to boost technician performance. With Acronis RMM, MSPs can
deliver superior IT administration and monitoring services while improving security posture for both
endpoints and Microsoft 365.

MSP business models. Acronis PSA features service desk, billing and invoicing, contract and
quotation management, stock inventory and project management, and insightful KPI reports. Part of
Acronis Cyber Protect Cloud, Acronis PSA is natively integrated with Acronis RMM, cybersecurity and
data protection in a single console and offers comprehensive integrations with third-party RMM and
accounting systems.

`Career Opportunities`

### ASCMI’s Certification Will Get You Practical Skills That Set You Apart

Hiring managers don’t want memorized facts. They want proven defenders.You’ll graduate with a
portfolio, a toolkit, and the battle scars that prove you’re ready to own a cybersecurity career.
* #### CTF Challenges
  
  Capture the flag scenarios that sharpen real-time hacking and defense instincts.
* #### Capstone Breach Simulation
  
  Architect an enterprise defense, survive a full-scale attack, and prove your strategy in a
  simulated boardroom defense briefing.
* #### SIEM and Threat Hunting Labs
  
  Master tools like Splunk and Elastic for threat detection, response, and proactive hunting.
* #### Penetration Testing Playbooks
  
  Go beyond theory with full-scope penetration testing across cloud, mobile, network, and IoT
  landscapes.
* #### Cloud Security Deployments
  
  Build multi-layered defenses in AWS, Azure, and hybrid clouds with live case studies.

`how it works`

### How to Get Started with ACSMI’s Cybersecurity Certification, Step-by-Step Process

Starting your cybersecurity career with ACSMI’s Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification is
simple and streamlined. Here’s how you can get started:

**ACSMI makes it easier than ever to transition from where you are now — to where cybersecurity’s
future needs you.**
* ## 01. Choose Your Enrollment Option:
  
  Select your preferred plan — full access, mentorship upgrade, or flexible 12-month payments
  starting at just $208/month.
  
  [Choose Your Enrollment Option]
* ## 02. Complete Your Registration
  
  Register securely through our online portal. You'll get instant access to your learning dashboard,
  course materials, and support channels.
  
  [Complete Your Registration]
* ## 03. Attend Orientation and Launch
  
  Start with a welcome session to map your learning path. Whether you choose the 8-week fast-track
  or 3–6 month self-paced option, you’ll have complete guidance from day one.
  
  [Attend Orientation and Launch]
* ## 04. Dive Into Interactive Learning
  
  Begin hands-on labs, CTF challenges, live webinars, and real-world simulations, all while building
  your cybersecurity portfolio.
  
  [Dive Into Interactive Learning]
* ## 05. Complete Certification Exams
  
  Defend a breach simulation, finish your capstone project, and prepare for certifications like
  CISSP, CEH, OSCP, and more
  
  [Complete Certification Exams]
* ## 06. Advance Your Career
  
  Walk away not just with a CPD-accredited certificate, but a battle-tested cybersecurity resume
  employers recognize and trust.
  
  [Advance Your Career]

`What You Will Learn`

## How You’ll Learn: Fast-Track or Flex Through ACSMI’s Cybersecurity Certification

Your life isn’t on pause, and your career ambitions shouldn’t be either. That’s why ACSMI’s Advanced
Cybersecurity & Management Certification gives you complete control over your timeline:

Both tracks deliver **the same powerhouse curriculum**, labs, capstone defense, and certification
preparation, just built around your reality, not someone else's.

[Fast-Track Option]

Fast-Track Option

Complete your full certification in as little as **8 weeks** through an intensive, structured
bootcamp experience, perfect for career changers and go-getters ready to dive in.

[Self-Paced Flexibility]

Self-Paced Flexibility

Need balance? Take **3–6 months** to work through the curriculum around your job, family, or
existing studies, with no deadlines locking you down.

`Who Needs Us`

### Who ACSMI’s Dual Cybersecurity & Management Certification Is Built For

Cybersecurity has no one-size-fits-all, and neither does ACSMI’s Advanced Cybersecurity & Management
Certification. Wherever you're starting, ACSMI doesn’t just prepare you for a cybersecurity job —
**it prepares you to lead the future of security itself.**

Launch your career with leadership-grade credentials and skills that outpace entry-level
competition.

deliver.

[IT Professionals]

#### **IT Professionals**

threat intelligence.

[Security Analysts]

#### **Security Analysts**

[Aspiring CISOs]

# Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification | ACSMI Online Training

The [Advanced Cybersecurity Management Institute (ACSMI)][90] provides professional cybersecurity
certification and management training online. ACSMI is NOT affiliated with the American College of
Sports Medicine (ACSM) — we are a dedicated cybersecurity education organization focused on
multi-domain security training.

Earn your Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification (ACSMC) through our CPD-accredited and
ACE college credit-recognized program. Whether you're a [career changer][91], IT professional, or
[aspiring CISO][92], this comprehensive cybersecurity training program delivers the skills employers
demand.

This CPD-accredited and ACE college credit recognized online cybersecurity certification is designed
to bridge the gap between theory and real-world skills. Gain new career opportunities with our
professional cybersecurity certification that provides affordable yet high-quality training across
industries and skillsets to preserve lifetime career success and easier career pivots.

### ASCMI’s Certification Will Get You Practical Skills That Set You Apart

Hiring managers don’t want memorized facts. They want proven defenders.You’ll graduate with a
portfolio, a toolkit, and the battle scars that prove you’re ready to own a cybersecurity career.
* #### CTF Challenges
  
  Capture the flag scenarios that sharpen real-time hacking and defense instincts.
* #### Capstone Breach Simulation
  
  Architect an enterprise defense, survive a full-scale attack, and prove your strategy in a
  simulated boardroom defense briefing.
* #### SIEM and Threat Hunting Labs
  
  Master tools like Splunk and Elastic for threat detection, response, and proactive hunting.
* #### Penetration Testing Playbooks
  
  Go beyond theory with full-scope penetration testing across cloud, mobile, network, and IoT
  landscapes.

`how it works`

### How to Get Started with ACSMI’s Cybersecurity Certification, Step-by-Step Process

Starting your cybersecurity career with ACSMI’s Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification is
simple and streamlined. Here’s how you can get started:

**ACSMI makes it easier than ever to transition from where you are now — to where cybersecurity’s
future needs you.**
* ## 01. Choose Your Enrollment Option:
  
  Select your preferred plan — full access, mentorship upgrade, or flexible 12-month payments
  starting at just $208/month.
  
  [Choose Your Enrollment Option]
* ## 02. Complete Your Registration
  
  Register securely through our online portal. You'll get instant access to your learning dashboard,
  course materials, and support channels.
  
  [Complete Your Registration]
* ## 03. Attend Orientation and Launch
  
  Start with a welcome session to map your learning path. Whether you choose the 8-week fast-track
  or 3–6 month self-paced option, you’ll have complete guidance from day one.
  
  [Attend Orientation and Launch]
* ## 04. Dive Into Interactive Learning
  
  Begin hands-on labs, CTF challenges, live webinars, and real-world simulations, all while building
  your cybersecurity portfolio.
  
  [Dive Into Interactive Learning]
* ## 05. Complete Certification Exams
  
  Defend a breach simulation, finish your capstone project, and prepare for certifications like
  CISSP, CEH, OSCP, and more
  
  [Complete Certification Exams]
* ## 06. Advance Your Career
  
  Walk away not just with a CPD-accredited certificate, but a battle-tested cybersecurity resume
  employers recognize and trust.
  
  [Advance Your Career]

preparation, just built around your reality, not someone else's.

Fast-Track Option

Complete your full certification in as little as **8 weeks** through an intensive, structured

[Self-Paced Flexibility]

][27]

ARIA Zero Trust PROTECT (AZT PROTECT™) is a comprehensive AI driven defense system that protects all
your OT endpoints from ALL cybersecurity threats – known and unknown.

This breakthrough patented solution represents a leap forward in the evolution of cybersecurity,
surpassing anything available today. It protects your entire OT device infrastructure and critical
IT applications no matter their location, safeguarding your revenue and reputation. It automatically
blocks virtually all vulnerabilities from exploit at the application and OS level.

### **A Better Approach to Cyber-Attack Detection, Response, and Containment**

][30]
[[Cyber Security Expert]][31]

We took a different path when developing our threat detection and response solutions. Unlike other
providers, we monitor all the network traffic and generate analytics to enable complete
enterprise-wide visibility.

This helps our solutions assist in the identification and disruption of attacks in two important
ways: improve the performance of your existing security stack or deploy automated and full AI-driven
SOC capabilities within a single platform. Customers in a range of industries rely on our solutions
to improve their security posture—no matter their environment.

[Learn More][32]
[

### **AI-SOC Run From the Cloud or On-Premise – The Choice is Yours**

][33]

Our ARIA CloudADR solution is a fully AI-automated, cloud-based virtual SOC that provides an
attractive entry point for companies that need to protect both on-premises and public cloud
infrastructure for pennies on the dollar compared to running a physical SOC. Any ARIA CloudADR can
be upgraded to a full ARIA ADR solution with the deployment of a network-attached platform capable
of detecting and stopping all types of network-borne threats and attacks involving the premises

Both solutions include the equivalent functionality of seven different security tools, all of which
are replaced by more advanced ML-based threat detection models driven by AI. As a result, only
confirmed threats and/or cyber-attacks are presented and stopped in minutes as they become
active—all without human involvement.

### **What Our Customers Say**

“The ARIA solution was therefore the perfect addition to our cybersecurity portfolio, allowing us to
address high-value customers across multiple vertical industries with a best-in-class solution.”

**– Peter Moore, Managing Director of Logi-Tech**

[Learn More][26]
[

## **Can your OT network guard against the unknown?**

][27]

ARIA Zero Trust PROTECT (AZT PROTECT™) is a comprehensive AI driven defense system that protects all
your OT endpoints from ALL cybersecurity threats – known and unknown.

This breakthrough patented solution represents a leap forward in the evolution of cybersecurity,
surpassing anything available today. It protects your entire OT device infrastructure and critical
IT applications no matter their location, safeguarding your revenue and reputation. It automatically
blocks virtually all vulnerabilities from exploit at the application and OS level.

[LEARN MORE][28]

[[ARIA AZT PROTECT Image]][29]

[

### **A Better Approach to Cyber-Attack Detection, Response, and Containment**

][30]
[[Cyber Security Expert]][31]

We took a different path when developing our threat detection and response solutions. Unlike other
providers, we monitor all the network traffic and generate analytics to enable complete
enterprise-wide visibility.

This helps our solutions assist in the identification and disruption of attacks in two important
ways: improve the performance of your existing security stack or deploy automated and full AI-driven
SOC capabilities within a single platform. Customers in a range of industries rely on our solutions
to improve their security posture—no matter their environment.

[Learn More][32]
[

### **AI-SOC Run From the Cloud or On-Premise – The Choice is Yours**

][33]

Our ARIA CloudADR solution is a fully AI-automated, cloud-based virtual SOC that provides an
attractive entry point for companies that need to protect both on-premises and public cloud
infrastructure for pennies on the dollar compared to running a physical SOC. Any ARIA CloudADR can
be upgraded to a full ARIA ADR solution with the deployment of a network-attached platform capable
of detecting and stopping all types of network-borne threats and attacks involving the premises

Both solutions include the equivalent functionality of seven different security tools, all of which
are replaced by more advanced ML-based threat detection models driven by AI. As a result, only
confirmed threats and/or cyber-attacks are presented and stopped in minutes as they become
active—all without human involvement.

[LEARN MORE][34]

ASIS International is a global community of 34,000+ security professionals across industries and
disciplines, and at all career stages. Join us to benefit from knowledge-sharing opportunities,
valuable resources, and peer-to-peer connections.

[ Become a Member ][61]

When you become a member of ASIS, you gain a network and valuable tools to expand your knowledge and
build your career—no matter your level of experience.

Kick-start your security career with ASIS. Build your network through local chapters and mentoring.
Access career development resources through ASIS Upskill. Gain industry expertise with free webinars
and discounted certificate programs, and stand out to employers with the APP certification.

[Advancing Professional]

## Advancing Professional

Take your security career to the next level with ASIS. Expand your network through local chapters.
Refine your leadership skills with Career HQ and mentoring. Stay up to date with access to Standards
& Guidelines and earn career-advancing certifications with exclusive member discounts.

[Seasoned Leader]

## Seasoned Leader

Elevate your impact with ASIS. Lead the community as a mentor or chapter leader. Connect with global
peers at premier, in-person events. Stay sharp with executive education and strengthen your
organization with free or discounted access to industry standards and leadership-focused
certifications.

# System Integration & Cybersecurity for Modern Organizations

PT. Arahan Bahtera Teknologi membantu Anda mengintegrasikan infrastruktur TI dan mengamankan aset
digital—mulai dari desain arsitektur, implementasi, hingga operasi keamanan. Secure your own future.

[ Konsultasi ][7] [ Lihat Layanan ][8]

## About Us

### Who We Are

PT. Arahan Bahtera Teknologi adalah perusahaan **System Integrator** dan **Cybersecurity Services**
yang membantu organisasi merancang, mengintegrasikan, dan mengamankan ekosistem TI. Kami
menggabungkan keahlian infrastruktur (network, server, cloud) dengan praktik keamanan (assessment,
hardening, monitoring, incident response) agar sistem berjalan **stabil**, **terukur**, dan
**aman**.

Fokus kami adalah kemitraan jangka panjang: dari konsultasi, implementasi, hingga layanan terkelola.

System Integration
Network & Infrastructure
Security Assessment
Managed Security

## Our Services

Layanan System Integrator & Cybersecurity yang siap disesuaikan dengan kebutuhan organisasi Anda.

## Our Partners

Kami berkolaborasi dengan partner teknologi untuk menghadirkan solusi System Integrator &

# BIBEK JYOTI ROY

Cybersecurity Expert & Serial Entrepreneur

On a mission to build a secure digital world, empowering individuals and businesses against the
ever-evolving landscape of cyber threats.

## / ABOUT ME

Bibek Jyoti Roy is an Indian cybersecurity expert and entrepreneur. He has made significant
contributions in the fields of programming, bug bounty, penetration testing, and Open Source
Intelligence (OSINT). He has helped many companies, such as IND Money and Phind, identify security
vulnerabilities in their systems. In 2021, he founded Psylinks Security, a company dedicated to
providing advanced cybersecurity solutions, and has since expanded into education, blockchain, open
research, and health & wellness sectors with multiple ventures aimed at creating positive societal
impact.

### Personal

Born: 23 September 2002 (age 22)

Location: Guwahati, Assam, India

Parents: Bijan Roy & Juthika Roy

### Education

An enterprise tech company dedicated to protecting businesses and individuals from cyber threats
through advanced threat detection, data protection, and customized security strategies.

### Blockvizion

Founded: 2023

A forward-thinking venture exploring the applications of blockchain technology to enhance data
security, transparency, and create decentralized solutions for modern digital challenges.

### Tutoring Point

Founded: 2024

An education service startup dedicated to providing high-quality, personalized learning experiences.
Tutoring Point connects students with dedicated educators for tailored home tutoring and academic
support.

### Codesity

Founded: 2025

An independent open research company operating as a fully private, not-for-profit entity. Conducts
rigorous research and development across technology, medicine, food science, and education systems.
All findings and innovations are made freely accessible to society, advancing human knowledge and
wellbeing without commercial constraints or external influence.

### Cafel

Founded: 2025

Guwahati's premier healthy dining destination in Jyotikuchi, offering scientifically-designed meals
that heal and nourish. Features traditional Indian and authentic Assamese cuisine made with 100%
organic, farm-fresh ingredients—no preservatives, chemicals, or refined oils. Every dish is cooked
fresh to order for genuine well-being.

## / VISION

"My vision extends beyond simply reacting to threats. I believe in proactive, intelligent security
that anticipates and neutralizes risks before they can cause harm. We are moving towards a future
where cybersecurity is not a barrier, but an enabler of innovation and trust."

"Through my ventures, we are committed to continuous research and development, staying ahead of the
curve and building a resilient digital infrastructure for the next generation of technology. From
securing digital assets to advancing open scientific research and nourishing physical health, each
venture serves a purpose in creating a better, more equitable tomorrow where knowledge and wellbeing
are accessible to all."

[[CB Insights Logo]][1]
[AI & Agents][2]

### Tools
* [
  Strategy Terminal
  
  Predictive AI web app for company discovery, analysis, and tracking
  
  ][3]
* [
  Mobile app
  
  Predictive AI on your phone
  
  ][4]
* [
  Browser Extension
  
  Analyzes companies (and more) while you view their website
  
  ][5]

### Agents
* [
  Team of Agents
  
  Available for company scouting, due diligence, new business acquisition, M&A, and more. In our
  Strategy Terminal or standalone.
  
  ][6]

### Key Features
* [
  ChatCBI™
  
  Strategy LLM powered with our predictive data and analysis — the most powerful way to use our
  tools
  
  ][7]
* [
  Company Analysis
  
  Set of agents to analyze companies and their investor and commercial relationships
  
  ][8]
* [
  Company profiles — 11M+
  
  Predictive intelligence data. Double verified.
  
  ][9]
* [
  Tech market rankings — 1,600+ markets
  
  Ranks market entrants. Compare win reasons, execution, funding, and more.
  
  ][10]
* [
  Intelligent Watchlists and Alerts
  
  Insight before you ask
  
  ][11]

### Security
* [
  Security and privacy
  
  SOC 2, GDPR, and more. No training on your data.
  
  ][12]

[Data][13]

### Predictive
* [
  Mosaic Score
  
  Health and growth potential — with sub-scores on growth, financial strength, industry health, and
  management team strength
  
  ][14]
* [
  Commercial Maturity
  
  Ability to compete and partner
  
  ][15]
* [
  Exit Probability
  
  Broken out by IPO and M&A
  
  ][16]
* [
  Customer Sentiment
  
  Client satisfaction scores and likelihood to renew
  
  ][17]
* [
  Tech market rankings — 1,600+ markets
  
  Ranks, scores, and compares entrants
  
  ][18]
* [
  Business relationships — customer, partner, vendor
  
  Reveals strategy and sales opps
  
  ][19]

### Financial
* [
  Funding and valuations
  
  Comprehensive history for companies and investors
  
  ][20]
* [
  Private company revenues
  
  Sourced direct from startups and public and non-public sources
  
  ][21]
* [
  Public company financials
  
  Earnings, stock performance, financials, and more
  
  ][22]

### Research
* [
  Advanced human-led research
  
  Expert analyst team covering key industries and tech
  
  ][23]

### Foundational
* [
  Taxonomies
  
  Competitor, market, business model, and more
  
  ][24]
* [
  Firmographics — 11M+ private companies
  
  Hard-to-find data from startups, customers, and investors — plus public and non-public sources
  worldwide
  
  ][25]
* [
  Media and patents
  
  Tracking and historical database

### Cisco Cloud Control

The unified platform with one shared view across every IT domain.

[Discover Cisco Cloud Control][29]
[AI Canvas London Network Troubleshooting results]

### Enterprise operations at agentic AI speed

Move beyond visibility to autonomous operations with trusted, policy-bound agents that execute
complex workflows at machine speed—while humans govern intent, policy, and risk.

[Discover AI Canvas][30]
[AI networking]

### Resilient, high-speed AI networking

AI-optimized networking that unifies scale, speed, and resilience—so AI workloads run faster, more
efficiently, and at global scale.

[See what's new][31]
[Cisco Silicon One processor on a circuit board in shades of blue and grey]

### Silicon to power AI-scale networking

Purpose-built programmable silicon powers networks with leading performance, efficiency, and scale –
optimized for AI workloads across hyperscalers, service providers, enterprises, and data centers.

[Explore Silicon One][32]
[Sunset over a city skyline with a dense network of glowing lights across the foreground]

### Distributed, optimized enforcement

Deliver zero-trust segmentation and application protection with a highly-distributed security fabric
and unified management across data center, cloud, campus, and IoT environments.

[Explore Hybrid Mesh Firewall][33]
[Close-up of networking equipment with multiple ports and visible Cisco logo]

### Security fused into the network

Security is embedded at every layer of the network, scaling to support any AI application while
simplifying even the most sophisticated campus and enterprise environment.

[Learn about Smart Switches][34]
[Close-up of networking equipment featuring Ethernet ports, status LEDs, and network icons]

### The AI-ready platform the edge demands

Redefine edge computing with a full-stack platform that delivers data center performance,
modularity, centralized management, and built-in security where you need it most.

[See the future of the edge][35]
[Cisco IQ Assets Overview dashboard featuring a total assets count, coverage percentage, and AI
Assistant messages]

### Cisco IQ

Cisco IQ is the unified AI-powered experience that delivers real-time insights, assessments,
troubleshooting, learning, automation, and agent-driven guidance to power Cisco support and
professional services.

[Learn about Cisco IQ][36]
[glow background]

## Powering outcomes you need to thrive in the AI era

### AI-ready data centers

Modernize and transform your data centers to power traditional and AI workloads anywhere—with speed,

# Connected Future

CoreSite delivers the digital infrastructure powering your growth — combining scalable space,
reliable power and high-performance interconnection across key U.S. markets. With direct access to
leading cloud and network ecosystems, we provide the secure foundation enterprises need to scale,
innovate and succeed.

[Explore Data Centers][171]
[Why CoreSite][172]

[Gartner_Colocation Guide_Official_Thumbnail_700-pixels]

[Gartner_logo_RGB]

### **CoreSite Recognized in the Gartner^{® }*Market Guide for Data Center Colocation***

**The *****Market Guide for Data Center Colocation** *from Gartner highlights what matters most when
evaluating providers — from reliable space and power to scalability, compliance and connectivity. We
believe CoreSite’s recognition in this comprehensive guide reinforces our role as a trusted partner
for today’s IT needs and tomorrow’s innovation.

[DOWNLOAD YOUR COMPLIMENTARY MARKET GUIDE][173]

### Where You Put Your Infrastructure Matters

**Explore how CoreSite centralizes direct access to all your partners in your digital workflow.**

## WHY CORESITE

For over 20 years customers have trusted our expert teams to deliver the operational excellence and
next-generation solutions required to execute their hybrid IT strategies.

4.8M+ SQUARE FEET
CoreSite owns and operates 30 network-dense, cloud-enabled data centers, totaling more than 4.8
million square feet, in 11 strategic U.S. markets.
44K+ CUSTOMER INTERCONNECTIONS
Growth depends on reaching new markets and building connections. CoreSite’s ecosystem empowers
connectivity and creates new revenue opportunities.
70% COST SAVINGS
Leveraging CoreSite’s direct connections to all the major cloud providers, customers see up to 70%
cost savings in reduced egress fees.*
[LEARN WHY BUSINESSES CHOOSE CORESITE][174]

*Costs savings are based on CoreSite cost comparisons using publicly available and private
information and/or CoreSite customer reported costs savings and may not be indicative of the costs
savings that may be experienced by every customer that switches to the applicable CoreSite service.

## Our Products and Services

**Accelerating your compute-intensive and latency-sensitive applications, CoreSite provides
high-density colocation, low-latency interconnection and native cloud onramps to help monetize your
business and ensure it is future-ready.**

Partnering with CoreSite cut Georgia IT’s connectivity costs tenfold over the market rate, shrinking

[LEARN HOW][179]

**AI Platform Provider**

Leveraging CoreSite’s colocation solution, Seceon has grown by more than 100% just in the last year

# CyberArk is now Idira

## The next-generation platform that secures every identity for the AI enterprise.

[Learn More][117]

### Secure every identity — human, machine and AI — with the right level of privilege controls.

Watch the Video
[ [play button]][118]
[people sitting at a conference desk]

### Secure identities.
### Shut out attackers.

Seamlessly secure identities throughout the cycle of accessing any resource across any
infrastructure, including hybrid, SaaS and multi-cloud. The CyberArk identity security platform is
the first line of defense against malicious actors and unauthorized access to protect what matters
most.

[Request a Demo][119]


#### Seamless & secure access for all identities

By combining secure SSO, Adaptive MFA, Lifecycle Management, Directory Services and User Behavior
Analytics, we help you streamline operations and give users simple and secure access to
resources—on-premises, cloud, hybrid—from any location, using any device.


#### Intelligent privilege controls

Apply world-class intelligent privilege controls across the IT estate, as well as differentiated
controls to secure the unique needs of workforce users, third-party vendors, endpoints and machine
identities as they access sensitive data.


#### Flexible identity automation & orchestration

Streamline HR processes, ensure users have the right access to the right resources, enable
compliance with industry or government regulations, and improve efficiencies across the board with
orchestration and lifecycle management, permissions and entitlements, and directory and federation
services.

### Identity Security Defined

Centered on intelligent privilege controls, identity security seamlessly secures access for all
identities and flexibly automates the identity lifecycle with continuous threat detection and
prevention — all with a unified approach.

[Explore the Platform][120]

[CyberArk Platform Graphic]

## Apply intelligent privilege controls across the entire identity lifecycle

##### Expand intelligent privilege controls that were designed for the most privileged user, such as
##### an admin, to a broader range of human and machine identities, whenever standing or
##### just-in-time access is required.

[


#### Workforce & Customer Access

Ensure that the right users have secure access to the right resources at the right times, by
protecting workforce and customer credentials and tightly controlling access to on-premises and
cloud-based applications, services and IT infrastructure.

][121]

[Learn More][122]

[


#### Endpoint Privilege Security

Take control over unmanaged privilege on the endpoints to significantly reduce the area of attack
and defend from threats by removing local admin rights, enforcing role-specific least privilege and
improving audit-readiness.

][123]

[Learn More][124]

[


#### Privileged Access Management

Secure privileged credentials and secrets with comprehensive capabilities for operating systems,
endpoints, cloud infrastructure and workloads, servers, databases, applications, hypervisors,
network devices, security appliances and more.

][125]

[Learn More][126]

[


#### Secrets Management

Secure and manage the secrets and credentials used by applications, machines and other non-human
identities to access IT and other sensitive resources across both enterprise and external IT
environments.

][127]

[Learn More][128]

[


#### Cloud Security

Extend privilege controls to cloud environments by analyzing, securing and monitoring access.
Discover and remove excessive permissions by visualizing access for human, machine and federated
identities.

][129]

[Learn More][130]

[


#### Identity Management

Automate the management of digital identities across enterprise IT environments and centrally
create, maintain and analyze access to right-size permissions on the journey to least privilege.

][131]

[Learn More][132]

### Threat research and innovation: CyberArk Labs

###### A team of researchers dedicated to examining emerging attack techniques so that organizations
###### everywhere can strengthen their security posture.

[
[Passkey Global Breakthrough]

February 2, 2026

#### The art of the invisible key: Passkey global breakthrough

Introduction Passkeys now protects billions of accounts, redefining how the world signs in through
stronger, more secure authentication without a password. Yet this global movement runs deeper than
most realize. While passkeys implements thoroughly scrutinized...

# CyberArk is now Idira

## The next-generation platform that secures every identity for the AI enterprise.

[Learn More][117]

### Secure every identity — human, machine and AI — with the right level of privilege controls.

Watch the Video
[ [play button]][118]
[people sitting at a conference desk]

### Secure identities.
### Shut out attackers.

Seamlessly secure identities throughout the cycle of accessing any resource across any
infrastructure, including hybrid, SaaS and multi-cloud. The CyberArk identity security platform is
the first line of defense against malicious actors and unauthorized access to protect what matters
most.

[Request a Demo][119]


#### Seamless & secure access for all identities

By combining secure SSO, Adaptive MFA, Lifecycle Management, Directory Services and User Behavior
Analytics, we help you streamline operations and give users simple and secure access to
resources—on-premises, cloud, hybrid—from any location, using any device.


#### Intelligent privilege controls

Apply world-class intelligent privilege controls across the IT estate, as well as differentiated
controls to secure the unique needs of workforce users, third-party vendors, endpoints and machine
identities as they access sensitive data.


#### Flexible identity automation & orchestration

Streamline HR processes, ensure users have the right access to the right resources, enable
compliance with industry or government regulations, and improve efficiencies across the board with
orchestration and lifecycle management, permissions and entitlements, and directory and federation
services.

### Identity Security Defined

Centered on intelligent privilege controls, identity security seamlessly secures access for all
identities and flexibly automates the identity lifecycle with continuous threat detection and
prevention — all with a unified approach.

[Explore the Platform][120]

[CyberArk Platform Graphic]

## Apply intelligent privilege controls across the entire identity lifecycle

##### Expand intelligent privilege controls that were designed for the most privileged user, such as
##### an admin, to a broader range of human and machine identities, whenever standing or
##### just-in-time access is required.

[

Ensure that the right users have secure access to the right resources at the right times, by
protecting workforce and customer credentials and tightly controlling access to on-premises and
cloud-based applications, services and IT infrastructure.

and defend from threats by removing local admin rights, enforcing role-specific least privilege and
improving audit-readiness.

Secure privileged credentials and secrets with comprehensive capabilities for operating systems,
endpoints, cloud infrastructure and workloads, servers, databases, applications, hypervisors,
network devices, security appliances and more.

][125]

[


#### Secrets Management

Secure and manage the secrets and credentials used by applications, machines and other non-human
identities to access IT and other sensitive resources across both enterprise and external IT
environments.

][127]

[Learn More][128]

[


#### Cloud Security

Extend privilege controls to cloud environments by analyzing, securing and monitoring access.
Discover and remove excessive permissions by visualizing access for human, machine and federated
identities.

][129]

[Learn More][130]

#### Identity Management

Automate the management of digital identities across enterprise IT environments and centrally
create, maintain and analyze access to right-size permissions on the journey to least privilege.

leading enterprises, delivering unmatched reliability, security, and innovation to power your
transformation.

# Explore The Leading Global Data Center Database!

No results found.

Explore Map[Get a Quote][3][Get Dataset][4]

About

## Data Center Map

Launched in 2007, Data Center Map was the first research tool of its kind. We operate a global data
center directory, mapping data center locations worldwide. Our intention is to make it easier for
buyers, sellers, investors, regulators and other professionals working with the industry to gain
insights into the markets of their interest.

## Colocation, Cloud and Connectivity

We cover a wide range of data center services, but our primary focus is colocation, cloud and
connectivity. Our scope extends further, offering insights and statistics on hyperscalers, edge
computing, AI, real estate, network carriers, cloud operators or other digital infrastructure, Data
Center Map is the resource you need.

[Data Center Database][5][Cloud Provider Database][6][Internet Exchange Database][7]

## Procurement & Search Tools

We aim to make it easier for buyers to identify and connect with suitable providers/operators. You
can use our platform to do your own research and contact operators directly. Alternatively, we can
assist with obtaining quotes or guide you through the entire process, from understanding your needs
to finding and engaging with matching providers.

[Get Quotes][8][Free Consultation][9][Data Center Promotions][10]

## Data & Intelligence

We have been tracking the industry since 2007, building one of the most comprehensive databases
available featuring data center locations. We cover power capacity, sizing and many other aspects
relating to supply and demand. If you are looking for a dataset to support your decisions, reach out
to learn more about our datasets available in a wide range of formats (CSV, GeoJSON, KMZ, Shape/SHP)
for integration with your own GIS tools or databases.

[Datasets: Database Exports][11]

## Reach In-Market Buyers

As thousands of visitors are using our database to research colocation, cloud and connectivity
daily, we are a leading channel available for reaching in-market buyers of data center services. We
offer banner advertising, sponsorships, content marketing, enhanced memberships and much more.

# Building for everyone

We build data centers that power essential technology and services as we invest in community
development and lead the industry in data security and sustainability.

[oklahoma-pry-steven-lozano-faith-lanham-2025-1108-rt.webp]

[Link to Youtube Video][27] (visible only when JS is disabled)

We build world-class data centers, providing the essential infrastructure that enables businesses,
governments, and individuals to connect with each other, championing an inclusive and sustainable
future for all.

## Cultivating growth in
## our data center communities

Play Pause

Data centers are the engine for the transition to the digital economy. They link people to a variety
of industries, from supermarkets and retailers to schools and nonprofits.

### Accelerating economies

Together, we are driving increased economic growth, supporting local innovation, and creating career
opportunities within each of our data center communities.

[View our progress][28]

### Workforce development

As a responsible neighbor, we are partnering with, and investing in, our data center communities to
provide sustained support through workforce development, educational opportunities, and other
beneficial initiatives. With inclusive access to AI and digital opportunities, we can better prepare
communities to thrive for generations.

[See how we invest in our neighbors][29]
Play Pause

Google is proud to operate multiple data centers in Northern Virginia — a global hub of the digital
economy — and to support community organizations there that are enabling people and changing lives.
We've collaborated with two inspiring local organizations in the region, Global Inheritance and
Mobile Hope, to introduce more young women to science, technology, engineering, and math (STEM) and
to combat youth homelessness.

Play Pause

In Hamina, Finland, where Google has a data center, we are working with city-owned energy provider
Haminan Energia to kick off our first offsite heat recovery project to reduce our environmental
footprint, as well as help warm homes and businesses in this historic port city.

### Expanding access

Each day, we build for a tomorrow where everyone can benefit. We strengthen community connections by
investing in local initiatives like sustainability programs for young children. We enhance digital
integration with projects like rural internet connectivity. And we spark economic opportunities by
providing high-paying jobs through our infrastructure projects.

[See how we build for tomorrow][30]

## Building toward a more
## sustainable future

### We harness technology to spur positive environmental change

We aspire to build the most efficient computing systems, while caring for water resources and making
energy grids strong. We work with communities to ensure we responsibly power the products and
services our communities rely on.

[Discover how we’re operating sustainably][31]
[A team of solar panel installers work together on placing a panel into place on a solar farm in
Fredericia, Denmark, in collaboration with our data center.]

The Rødby Fjord solar project adds clean energy to the grid that powers our data center in
Fredericia, Denmark.

## Ensuring your data is
## safer and more secure

[A technician troubleshoots an issue between a row of servers in our The Dalles, Oregon, data
center.]

Denise inspects a central processing unit (CPU) at one of our data centers.

### We design our data centers with security in mind

Security is part of our data centers’ DNA. We custom build servers exclusively for our data centers,
and our industry-leading security team works 24/7 around the globe, making our facilities one of the
safest places for your data to live.

[See how we safeguard your data][32]

### Meet some of the people who collaborate with Google to benefit their communities.
* [A recent Google Skilled Trades and Readiness Program graduate sits outside on the curb, smiling.]
  
  Aurora Rodriguez
  
  Skilled Trades and Readiness (STAR) Program Graduate in Construction
  
  View more
  
  ## Aurora Rodriguez
  ## Northern Virginia, USA
  
  Skilled Trades and Readiness (STAR) Program Graduate in Construction
  
  Aurora Rodriguez has already built the foundation for a strong career. She credits her mom for
  giving her the strength and the gumption to begin pursuing her goals and dreams early. Her mom
  came to the United States from Honduras right after 9/11, and has worked the same job for the same
  salary since she began, working days and nights and taking the bus everywhere. This inspired
  Aurora to aim higher. She finished high school online so she could start working full time her
  sophomore year. “Everything I do is so she can have a better life and retirement.”
  
  Aurora always knew she wanted to work in the trades and began in welding. However, it became a
  challenge physically and financially to continue that work. She moved into logistical roles, yet a
  career in the trades still called to Aurora.
  
  That’s when she heard about Google’s Skilled Trades and Readiness (STAR) Program in Construction
  at Northern Virginia Community College. She completed the program in 2024, which has led to more
  project management opportunities at her job and a desire to go back to school and earn a four-year
  degree. Aurora’s mom is surely beaming with pride. “I remember the tough times, that no matter
  what, my mom made sure I pushed through.”
  [AURORA.png]
  [Aurora 02]
  
  ## “I came from a logistical background from Amazon to UPS stores. I was trying to prepare going
  ## back to school...and then I came upon the STAR Program.”
  
  ## “The STAR Program is making a difference in communities. It is giving opportunities to people
  ## who probably felt stuck just like I did.”
  
  Aurora Rodriguez
  STAR Program Graduate in Construction
  [Aurora-1.jpg]
* [Googler Marco Ynema stands near many bikes in Eemshaven, Netherlands]
  
  Marco Ynema
  
  Googler, Site Lead at Eemshaven Data Center
  
  View more
  
  ## Marco Ynema
  ## Eemshaven, Netherlands
  
  Googler, Site Lead at Eemshaven Data Center
  
  Marco Ynema, site lead at our Eemshaven data center in the Netherlands, is focused on growth,
  whether it’s for himself in his career, or in his proficiency as a musician and audio engineer, or
  in helping others.
  
  Born and raised in the Netherlands, Marco’s background is in computer science and audio
  engineering. He had ambitions for a career in music. Looking for stability as his family grew, he
  opted to pursue computer science and IT roles instead.
  
  Marco arrived at Google in 2005, contracting as a data center technician, but he was quickly hired
  a year later, moving to the U.S. to work with teams on site reliability engineering and software
  engineering. When he heard Google was building the Eemshaven data center, he shifted back to
  working within operations in the Netherlands. “The best place to raise my two daughters,” he says.
  
  As a site lead, he's observed Google’s evolution in the community, becoming more involved in
  outreach, including building school curriculum. Marco was involved in launching an apprenticeship
  program for local secondary institutions, hosting students at the Eemshaven data center, which led
  to full-time roles for some.
  
  In addition to seeing Google grow our commitments to the community, he enjoys helping people grow.
  “What I love most is to work together with my colleagues to build something and grow what we're
  working on and improve.”
  
  And music still plays a leading role in Marco’s life. He played in multiple bands over the years.
  Marco even built a recording studio in his backyard, ceaselessly focused on growing his talent.
  [Profile picture of Googler Marco Ynema in Eemshaven, Netherlands]
  [Googler Marco Ynema stands near many bikes in Eemshaven, Netherlands]
  
  ## “As we grow our presence, we see more interactions with the local community because we are part
  ## of the community. I also see it as our obligation to actually ensure that we are not only
  ## reaping the benefits from being here in this country, but by contributing by increasing
  ## infrastructure and creating opportunities and jobs and other things.”
  
  Marco Ynema
  Googler, Site Lead at Eemshaven Data Center
  [Googler Marco Ynema stands near a canal with boats floating by in Eemshaven, Netherlands]
  [Googler Marco Ynema plays his guitar in Eemshaven, Netherlands]

  giving her the strength and the gumption to begin pursuing her goals and dreams early. Her mom
  came to the United States from Honduras right after 9/11, and has worked the same job for the same
  salary since she began, working days and nights and taking the bus everywhere. This inspired
  Aurora to aim higher. She finished high school online so she could start working full time her
  sophomore year. “Everything I do is so she can have a better life and retirement.”
  
  Aurora always knew she wanted to work in the trades and began in welding. However, it became a
  challenge physically and financially to continue that work. She moved into logistical roles, yet a
  career in the trades still called to Aurora.
  
  That’s when she heard about Google’s Skilled Trades and Readiness (STAR) Program in Construction
  at Northern Virginia Community College. She completed the program in 2024, which has led to more
  project management opportunities at her job and a desire to go back to school and earn a four-year
  degree. Aurora’s mom is surely beaming with pride. “I remember the tough times, that no matter
  what, my mom made sure I pushed through.”
  [AURORA.png]
  [Aurora 02]
  
  ## “I came from a logistical background from Amazon to UPS stores. I was trying to prepare going
  ## back to school...and then I came upon the STAR Program.”
  
  ## “The STAR Program is making a difference in communities. It is giving opportunities to people
  ## who probably felt stuck just like I did.”
  
  Aurora Rodriguez
  STAR Program Graduate in Construction
  [Aurora-1.jpg]
* [Googler Marco Ynema stands near many bikes in Eemshaven, Netherlands]
  
  Marco Ynema
  
  Googler, Site Lead at Eemshaven Data Center
  
  View more
  
  ## Marco Ynema
  ## Eemshaven, Netherlands
  
  Googler, Site Lead at Eemshaven Data Center
  
  Marco Ynema, site lead at our Eemshaven data center in the Netherlands, is focused on growth,
  whether it’s for himself in his career, or in his proficiency as a musician and audio engineer, or
  in helping others.
  
  Born and raised in the Netherlands, Marco’s background is in computer science and audio
  engineering. He had ambitions for a career in music. Looking for stability as his family grew, he
  opted to pursue computer science and IT roles instead.
  
  Marco arrived at Google in 2005, contracting as a data center technician, but he was quickly hired
  a year later, moving to the U.S. to work with teams on site reliability engineering and software
  engineering. When he heard Google was building the Eemshaven data center, he shifted back to
  working within operations in the Netherlands. “The best place to raise my two daughters,” he says.
  
  As a site lead, he's observed Google’s evolution in the community, becoming more involved in
  outreach, including building school curriculum. Marco was involved in launching an apprenticeship
  program for local secondary institutions, hosting students at the Eemshaven data center, which led
  to full-time roles for some.
  
  In addition to seeing Google grow our commitments to the community, he enjoys helping people grow.
  “What I love most is to work together with my colleagues to build something and grow what we're
  working on and improve.”
  
  And music still plays a leading role in Marco’s life. He played in multiple bands over the years.
  Marco even built a recording studio in his backyard, ceaselessly focused on growing his talent.
  [Profile picture of Googler Marco Ynema in Eemshaven, Netherlands]
  [Googler Marco Ynema stands near many bikes in Eemshaven, Netherlands]
  
  ## “As we grow our presence, we see more interactions with the local community because we are part
  ## of the community. I also see it as our obligation to actually ensure that we are not only
  ## reaping the benefits from being here in this country, but by contributing by increasing
  ## infrastructure and creating opportunities and jobs and other things.”
  
  Marco Ynema
  Googler, Site Lead at Eemshaven Data Center

From powering enterprise AI to protecting data sovereignty, your clouds, data and AI workloads must
work as one—privately, at scale and free from lock-in.

[Explore Connectivity Solutions][57][Talk to Equinix][58]

## Enterprise AI is distributed everywhere.That's why you need Equinix.

The global infrastructure that connects your clouds, your data and your AI. Everywhere it runs.

[Explore Distributed AI][59][Talk to an expert][60]
AI demands more than a single cloud

Enterprise AI spans clouds, platforms and data. Equinix connects them so AI can run faster, better
and smarter.

AI runs where data lives

Equinix data centers unite clouds, networks and SaaS in one global ecosystem. Putting your AI closer
to the data and the compute it needs.

Sovereignty is non-negotiable

Keep data where regulations demand while scaling across clouds, partners and markets. All from one
unified platform.

Intelligence can't wait

The unequaled proximity of Equinix data centers put AI within milliseconds of the data and compute
it needs to scale.

From powering enterprise AI to protecting data sovereignty, your clouds, data and AI workloads must
work as one—privately, at scale and free from lock-in.

[Explore Connectivity Solutions][57][Talk to Equinix][58]

The global infrastructure that connects your clouds, your data and your AI. Everywhere it runs.

[Explore Distributed AI][59][Talk to an expert][60]
AI demands more than a single cloud

Enterprise AI spans clouds, platforms and data. Equinix connects them so AI can run faster, better
and smarter.

AI runs where data lives

Equinix data centers unite clouds, networks and SaaS in one global ecosystem. Putting your AI closer
to the data and the compute it needs.

Sovereignty is non-negotiable

Keep data where regulations demand while scaling across clouds, partners and markets. All from one
unified platform.

Intelligence can't wait

The unequaled proximity of Equinix data centers put AI within milliseconds of the data and compute
it needs to scale.

GDH is a global IT staffing and professional services firm committed to always delivering more.
Better talent. More client support. World-class workforce outcomes. Let’s get to work.

GDH helps organizations solve today’s most critical technology challenges through specialized talent
and professional services across:
* Artificial Intelligence & Intelligent Automation
* Data Engineering & Analytics
* Cybersecurity & Risk Management
* Cloud Transformation
* Application Development & Modernization
* DevOps & Platform Engineering

* Digital Transformation

Right from the start with GDH you will notice a difference. We’re a company driven by care. Genuine
care for our clients’ businesses and goals. Enthusiastic care for the career and life journeys of
our consultants and employees. Care to us is so much more than a nice idea. It’s fundamental to who

  International Energy Manufacturer
* > “GDH found me a role in a department that aligned with my careeer goals and offered a highly
  > competitive salary. Having the support of awesome people at GDH has been a life saver in my
  > career.”
  
  CFE Placed by GDH
* > “I am incredibly thankful to GDH for their consistent support and encouragement throughout the
  > onboarding process. From interview preparation to finalizing documents answering all my
  > questions, the team was always helpful and responsive. Their professionalism and genuine care
  > truly stood out.”

## What HostDir is, and why we built it this way.

Web infrastructure moves fast. Networks rearrange peering, registrars rotate ownership, data centers
open and close, BGP routes shift inside minutes. Keeping track of it while doing your day job is not
a small ask. We built HostDir to be the reference desk for the people who run the modern web.

The site you are reading is an editorial publication first. We run a news desk, we write long-form
pillar guides on the protocols and services that hold the internet together, and we maintain a
working directory of the hosting providers, data centers, networks and domain extensions you might
actually need. Free tools, no paywall, no signup. The hosting marketplace is one section of the
operation, not the entire site.

Editorial · HostDir desk

* [A daily news desk][96] on hosting, networks and security

* Every story is written by a human editor.
* Pillar guides are fact-checked against RFCs.
* Editorial ranking is not for sale.
* Sponsored slots are clearly labelled.
* Corrections are published inline.
What it costs
* Free to read. No paywall, no signup.

Editor's note The HostDir team · Updated 25 July 2026

## What HostDir is, and why we built it this way.

Web infrastructure moves fast. Networks rearrange peering, registrars rotate ownership, data centers
open and close, BGP routes shift inside minutes. Keeping track of it while doing your day job is not
a small ask. We built HostDir to be the reference desk for the people who run the modern web.

The site you are reading is an editorial publication first. We run a news desk, we write long-form
pillar guides on the protocols and services that hold the internet together, and we maintain a
working directory of the hosting providers, data centers, networks and domain extensions you might
actually need. Free tools, no paywall, no signup. The hosting marketplace is one section of the
operation, not the entire site.

Editorial · HostDir desk

* Every story is written by a human editor.

What it costs
* Free to read. No paywall, no signup.

## Celebrating 30 years of sparking growth

Built on 30 years of consistent growth, innovation, and trusted partnerships,
Infinigate has evolved from a regional cybersecurity distributor into a global platform spanning
Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia-Pacific.

With a proven record of double-digit growth, deep technical expertise, and a strong commitment to
collaboration, we continue to shape the future of cybersecurity distribution.

[See key evolutionary milestones][72]

As we celebrate this milestone, we invite partners and vendors to join us in accelerating shared
success, expanding opportunity, and setting new industry standards—together.

[Read blog post][73]

We are looking forward to meeting you at the EMEA Canalys Forum 2026, in **Barcelona, Spain on 6-8
October.**

## We focus on what matters: Cybersecurity, cloud and network infrastructure

We help you scope, design and deliver the solutions that matter most to your customers, delivering
major revenue gains for your business. Our fundamental building blocks are:

### Cybersecurity

Deliver high-margin cybersecurity solutions that span networks, datacentre infrastructure, cloud
infrastructure, endpoints, and everything in between.

[ Discover Cybersecurity ][83]

### Secure networks

Help your customers connect their mission-critical apps and data and deliver great end-user
experiences with intelligent, secure, high-performance networks.

[ Discover Secure networks ][84]

### Secure cloud

Engage with our expert Cloud business unit to help customers embrace the cloud with confidence,
giving them ease of deployment, security, access and as-a-service delivery model.

[ Discover Secure cloud ][85]

## Vendors who **spark your growth**

We’ve established relationships with the leading cybersecurity, secure networks and secure cloud
vendors. The result? Innovative, secure solutions that deliver fast ROI.

## Helping you unlock Secure cloud solutions

As your customers move their operations and apps to the cloud, they want to know that their IT is as
secure as possible.

We can help you support this transition and give your customers peace of mind with Infinigate Cloud
– our expert cloud business unit.
[ Find out more ][87]
[sales opportunities]

## IT services that **drive your business** and revenues

[Gartner predicts 9.4% year-on-year increase ][88]in spending on IT services in 2025. Are you ready
to seize this major revenue opportunity?

We have the skills and resources you need to boost your services revenues. We’ll help you select the
right services and support to complete your delivery capabilities.

If you want to upskill your teams and develop your own services capabilities, we deliver a range of
vendor-accredited training. 

**We can help you:**
* Bring new services to market faster to unlock new revenue streams
* Scale up your services capabilities rapidly – allowing you to bid for and win larger services
  deals
* Minimise financial risks, with transparent OPEX pricing for services
* Deepen your customer relationships based on embedded services engagements

## Unlock what matters most.

From unstructured data to unseen value, we help you protect, connect, and activate information to
tackle your most critical business challenges.
[backside of IM worker unpacking truck]
[old media film wrapped like a wheel]
[portrait of IM worker with files]

### Inventory management and logistics

Go from information to intelligence with our global inventory management and logistics services.
From records management to media services to fine art and consumer storage, discover why we’ve been
a trusted partner since 1951.
**Featured services and solutions:**
[Records and document storage][274]|[Smart records cleanup suite][275]|[Iron Mountain Warehousing
and Logistics][276]|[Media and entertainment services][277]
[Learn more][278]
[close up of wires in IM data center in arizona]
[Data Centers employee on a tablet]
[Data Centers Phoenix AZP-2 colocation]

### Data center solutions

Protect, connect, and activate your data with our global infrastructure solutions. With 30+ data
centers across 3 continents, explore how you can expand your footprint and join our 1,300+ customers
around the world, including highly regulated organizations & leading global hyperscalers.

**Featured services and solutions:**
[Data centers][279]|[Data centers locations][280]
[Learn more][281]
[an employee working on server in dark, illuminated by laptop light]
[two business people walking outside office building]
[pointing to ai]

### Digital platform and solutions

Don’t just mine your data, manage it. Recognized as a top-20 BPS provider, we combine trusted
information governance with Iron Mountain InSight® DXP, delivering AI-powered insights and workflow
automation across digital and physical content, trusted in 125 countries.
**Featured services and solutions:**
[Iron Mountain InSight DXP][282]|[InSight content management][283]|[Information governance advisory
services][284]|[InSight intelligent document processing][285]
[Learn more][286]
[it equipment]
[IM worker packaging IT assets for destruction closeup]
[closeup of IM worker disassembling IT assets]

### IT asset lifecycle management

We’re here to protect your data, drive IT efficiencies, and maximize the return on your IT hardware
investment. As the number one provider of ITAD in North America, we offer end-to-end services, from
deployment to disposition. Explore how we unlock value with a focus on IT reuse.
**Featured services and solutions:**
[Asset Lifecycle Management (ALM)][287]|[Data center decommissioning][288]|[IT asset disposition
(ITAD) ][289]
[Learn more][290]

## Every lap tells a story

The McLaren Mastercard Formula 1 Team knows that progress isn’t about looking back—it’s about
powering what comes next. We’re proud to partner with McLaren to help make heritage assets
accessible, connecting fans and partners to the stories that shaped the sport.

[Heritage fuels innovation][291]

today’s complex healthcare environment.
[Learn More][293]
Our vintage equipment reads 99% of all formats.

### Entertainment and media archives

Keep your assets safe with physical archive storage, asset care, and more.
[Learn More][294]
[library and archives, interior of a modern library]

### Library and archival services

### Fine arts

State-of-the-art storage facilities for top-notch art preservation.
[Visit Crozier Website][296]
[Crozier employees filling storage container]
220 US agencies are serviced by our public sector team.

### Public sector

Securely store assets and accelerate your digital transformation.
[Learn More][297]

### Small businesses

Enhance operational efficiency, improve customer service, prevent data loss and security breaches
for your business.
[Learn More][298]
80,000 small businesses rely on us for transformation.
[two energy workers pointing at windmills during sunset]

### Energy: oil and gas

By unlocking the power of information, energy companies can accelerate innovation, boost
sustainability, and reduce expenditures.
[Learn More][299]

## Unlock what matters most.

From unstructured data to unseen value, we help you protect, connect, and activate information to
tackle your most critical business challenges.
[backside of IM worker unpacking truck]
[old media film wrapped like a wheel]
[portrait of IM worker with files]

### Inventory management and logistics

Go from information to intelligence with our global inventory management and logistics services.
From records management to media services to fine art and consumer storage, discover why we’ve been
a trusted partner since 1951.
**Featured services and solutions:**
[Records and document storage][274]|[Smart records cleanup suite][275]|[Iron Mountain Warehousing
and Logistics][276]|[Media and entertainment services][277]
[Learn more][278]
[close up of wires in IM data center in arizona]
[Data Centers employee on a tablet]
[Data Centers Phoenix AZP-2 colocation]

### Data center solutions

Protect, connect, and activate your data with our global infrastructure solutions. With 30+ data
centers across 3 continents, explore how you can expand your footprint and join our 1,300+ customers
around the world, including highly regulated organizations & leading global hyperscalers.

**Featured services and solutions:**
[Data centers][279]|[Data centers locations][280]
[Learn more][281]
[an employee working on server in dark, illuminated by laptop light]
[two business people walking outside office building]
[pointing to ai]

### Digital platform and solutions

Don’t just mine your data, manage it. Recognized as a top-20 BPS provider, we combine trusted
information governance with Iron Mountain InSight® DXP, delivering AI-powered insights and workflow
automation across digital and physical content, trusted in 125 countries.
**Featured services and solutions:**
[Iron Mountain InSight DXP][282]|[InSight content management][283]|[Information governance advisory
services][284]|[InSight intelligent document processing][285]
[Learn more][286]
[it equipment]
[IM worker packaging IT assets for destruction closeup]
[closeup of IM worker disassembling IT assets]

### IT asset lifecycle management

We’re here to protect your data, drive IT efficiencies, and maximize the return on your IT hardware
investment. As the number one provider of ITAD in North America, we offer end-to-end services, from
deployment to disposition. Explore how we unlock value with a focus on IT reuse.
**Featured services and solutions:**
[Asset Lifecycle Management (ALM)][287]|[Data center decommissioning][288]|[IT asset disposition
(ITAD) ][289]
[Learn more][290]

#### Make the intelligent choice 

## Independent cloud for resilience and recovery 

While you may think your SaaS provider offers backup and recovery, that's actually your
responsibility. 

 

Manage resilience and retain control when faced with emerging technologies and the rise of
artificial intelligence (AI). Future-proof your data protection and ensure compliance with Keepit’s
independent cloud.

## Your data. Here today.
## Here tomorrow. 

#### **Resilience against data loss** 

Immutable protection for fast, reliable recovery - maintain control of your data and eliminate risk
while embracing new technologies.

#### **Independent cloud backup** 

Certified end-to-end with no third-party sub-processors: Keepit’s air-gapped architecture ensures
resilient recovery. 

#### **Easy and reliable data compliance** 

ISO 27001, ISAE 3402 certified. Stay compliant with GDPR, HIPAA, NIS2, NIST, and other global
regulations. 

## World Tour

Resilience starts with intelligent choices

Together, we will connect, empower, and protect. Join us in a city near you.

Keepit’s platform streamlines data protection with a single, intuitive dashboard across Microsoft
365, Salesforce, and more.  

 

Flat-rate pricing and unlimited always-hot data storage eliminates hidden costs, while our immutable
backup ensures resilience by keeping data secure, air-gapped, and always accessible. 

[Explore the platform][90]

#### Resilience against data loss 

## Air gapped for confident recovery 

Keepit offers unmatched security against data loss or ransomware attacks. By isolating backups, we
ensure full data integrity. With immutable backups and rapid recovery to a known-good-state, Keepit
enables resilience and gives you peace of mind when exploring advanced technologies, including AI.

[Keepit for disaster recovery][91]

#### Ensure business continuity 

## Easily enforce and document compliance  

With no third-party sub-processors and a no-transfer guarantee, Keepit’s independent cloud ensures
compliance with frameworks like NIS2, DORA, GDPR, HIPAA, and NIST. Support for internal policies,
audit-ready documentation, and customizable retention periods up to 99 years give you complete
control. Your data remains secure, private, and sovereign in your choice of 7 global regions.

## Database building for structured business records

**Microsoft Access** is a database builder for teams that outgrow spreadsheets but do not need a
full server setup. It stores information in **Relational tables** and lets users retrieve it with
**Query design**, so lists become searchable records that can be reused across projects. The logic
stays visible, making reviews easier.

### Top Recommended Alternative

][186]

**Microsoft Access** also supports fast data capture through a **Form builder** and consistent
outputs via **Report templates**. It works well for [inventory][187], [contacts][188], and
**internal tracking** where accuracy matters, though it still rewards careful planning when multiple
people touch the same file. Sharing works best when structure stays consistent.

### Turning records into a maintainable database

Microsoft Access shines when a team needs structured records with rules, not just freeform cells.
Using the **Relationships window**, it can connect records so one change updates everywhere, and
**Primary key enforcement** helps prevent duplicates. **Validation rules** keep entries within
expected ranges, which reduces cleanup later. That structure is a big plus for audits and repeatable
reporting, but it also means the [database][189] must be designed up front, or edits get messy as
requirements shift. It works best for departmental apps where ownership is clear and data
definitions stay stable.

Day to day, it feels like building a small app: data-entry screens, filtered views, and saved
outputs. **Import and export** handles CSV and workbook feeds, while **Linked data sources** let the
same front end point at shared records. **Macro actions** help automate repetitive steps without
deep coding. Performance stays solid for moderate datasets, but very large files or many edits at
the same time can strain a single database file. Design choices also affect speed. [Airtable][190]
and [FileMaker][191] are quicker for collaboration, while [SQLite][192] is leaner for embedded use.

For teams that need extra logic, **VBA scripting** can extend behavior, but it raises maintenance
costs when staff change. A safer pattern is **Split database design**, keeping shared data separate
from each user’s copy to reduce conflicts. Regular use of **Compact and Repair** helps control file
growth after heavy edits. The upside is strong local control and predictable behavior; the downside
is limited scale compared with [MySQL][193] or [PostgreSQL][194] when many users need access at
once. Clear ownership and backups keep it dependable for long-running departmental systems.

### A smart step beyond spreadsheets

Microsoft Access is a practical choice for small teams that need structured records and repeatable
results without standing up a full database server. It handles moderate datasets well, keeps
business rules easy to review, and supports clean handoffs when workbooks have become too fragile.
Setup still matters, and it won’t match the scale of MySQL or PostgreSQL, but for internal tracking
and departmental apps, it remains a dependable fit.

## Database building for structured business records

**Microsoft Access** is a database builder for teams that outgrow spreadsheets but do not need a
full server setup. It stores information in **Relational tables** and lets users retrieve it with
**Query design**, so lists become searchable records that can be reused across projects. The logic
stays visible, making reviews easier.

### Top Recommended Alternative
