**Microsoft Access** also supports fast data capture through a **Form builder** and consistent
outputs via **Report templates**. It works well for [inventory][187], [contacts][188], and
**internal tracking** where accuracy matters, though it still rewards careful planning when multiple
people touch the same file. Sharing works best when structure stays consistent.

### Turning records into a maintainable database

Microsoft Access shines when a team needs structured records with rules, not just freeform cells.
Using the **Relationships window**, it can connect records so one change updates everywhere, and
**Primary key enforcement** helps prevent duplicates. **Validation rules** keep entries within
expected ranges, which reduces cleanup later. That structure is a big plus for audits and repeatable
reporting, but it also means the [database][189] must be designed up front, or edits get messy as
requirements shift. It works best for departmental apps where ownership is clear and data
definitions stay stable.

Day to day, it feels like building a small app: data-entry screens, filtered views, and saved
outputs. **Import and export** handles CSV and workbook feeds, while **Linked data sources** let the
same front end point at shared records. **Macro actions** help automate repetitive steps without
deep coding. Performance stays solid for moderate datasets, but very large files or many edits at
the same time can strain a single database file. Design choices also affect speed. [Airtable][190]
and [FileMaker][191] are quicker for collaboration, while [SQLite][192] is leaner for embedded use.

For teams that need extra logic, **VBA scripting** can extend behavior, but it raises maintenance
costs when staff change. A safer pattern is **Split database design**, keeping shared data separate
from each user’s copy to reduce conflicts. Regular use of **Compact and Repair** helps control file
growth after heavy edits. The upside is strong local control and predictable behavior; the downside
is limited scale compared with [MySQL][193] or [PostgreSQL][194] when many users need access at
once. Clear ownership and backups keep it dependable for long-running departmental systems.

### A smart step beyond spreadsheets

Microsoft Access is a practical choice for small teams that need structured records and repeatable
results without standing up a full database server. It handles moderate datasets well, keeps
business rules easy to review, and supports clean handoffs when workbooks have become too fragile.
Setup still matters, and it won’t match the scale of MySQL or PostgreSQL, but for internal tracking
and departmental apps, it remains a dependable fit.

## The OI Value

We are partners of choice for Advisory & Integration of best-of-breed technology, including 3rd
party, Digital Experience, Master System Integration (MSI), Services, On-Premise, Cloud & Hybrid
Technologies. We bring deep expertise in co-innovation and co-creation of system infrastructure and
integration solutions with customers and develop end-to-end solutions in collaboration with
partners.

### Maximised Returns

Maximize your returns by optimizing energy efficiency, reduced maintenance costs and improving
occupant comfort. Our smart building solutions provide the insights that identify areas for
improvement, so building owners can enhance all ranges of their operations. With our real-time data
analytics and centralized dashboards, we ensure minimal waste and maximized performance.

### Increased Efficiency

Our smart building solutions are designed to optimize energy consumption, reduce maintenance costs
and enhance operational performance. Access simplified data analytics that lets you monitor and
regulate HVAC systems, lighting, security, room bookings, lifts, parking and more.

### Comfortable Occupants

Through leveraging IoT sensors and data analytics, our solutions can optimise indoor air quality,
temperature, lighting and other factors to enhance occupant comfort. This can lead to higher tenant
satisfaction and better retention rates. Our solutions provide essential tools for building a
positive reputation and attracting and retaining tenants.

## What We Offer

### Network System Integration

Operational Intelligence is responsible for designing networks, server solutions, wifi solutions and
cyber security strategies. Within these solutions we can tailor to a clients needs based on
different requirements including brands, levels of redundancy and scalability for future.

[ Learn More ][33]

### Digital Advisory

We live and breathe technology from R&D through to delivery and support making us a partner of
choice to deliver more sustainable and profitable digital building solutions.

The digital advisory is a key step to understanding the needs of our customers and transforming
these needs into a digital strategy and then a digital roadmap for deployment.

[ Learn More ][34]
[Digital Advisory][Digital Advisory]

### Master System Integrator

Operational Intelligence uses advanced knowledge of industry standards and best practises to
seamlessly integrate multiple building systems and subsystems in a cohesive and interoperable whole.
Utilising digital workflows and dashboarding, building owners can monitor multiple systems to
enhance user interoperability and building operations. These systems can include HVAC, lighting,
security, fire safety, access control and energy management systems.

FAQ

## You ask, we answer

Cloud Services
Cyber Security
Data Center Solutions
Digital Transformation
End User Computing
IMS
What kind of networking and content delivery solutions does Orient Technologies Limited offer?

Orient Technologies Limited offers a range of networking and content delivery network solutions.

What industries do you cater to?

We provide Cloud services to a wide range of industries, including Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, BFSI,
ITeS, Government-PSU and more.

How can a company prepare for cloud to cloud migration?

A company can prepare for cloud to cloud migration by performing a comprehensive inventory of its
current infrastructure, data, and applications, identifying potential compatibility issues or data
migration challenges, selecting a compatible cloud provider, and developing a migration plan that
includes testing and risk management measures

How can a company ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration?

A company can ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration by using encryption and secure
transfer protocols, implementing access controls and user authentication measures, and performing
regular security audits and risk assessments.

How can Orient Technologies Limited help us migrate our existing applications and data to the cloud?

Our team of experts can assist you with the planning, execution, and testing of your migration to
the cloud. We also offer automated tools and services to help you migrate your applications and data
quickly and efficiently.

What sets your cybersecurity solutions apart from competitors?

Full-spectrum Cybersecurity Solutions - From Cybersecurity Awareness, endpoint security to Cloud
Security and everything in between, Proactive threat intelligence, reducing vulnerabilities before
they escalate, Customizable security layers based on your unique business needs, Strategic
consulting through vCISO services, ensuring leadership-driven security frameworks, Cost-effective
scalability, offering enterprise-level security to businesses of all sizes.

What’s the ROI of investing in cybersecurity with Cyber Solutions?

Businesses that invest in proactive cybersecurity measures reduce breach costs by an average of 70%.

What industries benefit the most from your cybersecurity solutions?

Healthcare (PHI - protecting personal health information), Finance (Aligning with regulatory
compliances; safeguarding critical information assets), Retail & E-commerce (preventing data theft
and securing payment systems), Technology (safeguarding intellectual property), SMBs and enterprises
facing evolving digital threats.

How do your solutions ensure compliance with regulations like GDPR, HIPAA, or PCI DSS?

Our solutions are designed with compliance at their core. We offer frameworks and automated tools to
ensure your security practices align with industry regulations, minimizing risk and preventing
costly breaches.

How do you protect remote workforces and endpoints?

Through advanced Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) solutions, we secure devices across remote
environments.

How do I know which cybersecurity service is right for my business?

We offer a cyber risk assessment and an initial consultation to evaluate your current security
posture.

Can your solutions integrate with our existing security infrastructure?

Yes! Our services are designed to integrate seamlessly with your existing technology stack.

What kind of networking and content delivery solutions does Orient Technologies Limited offer?

Orient Technologies Limited offers a range of networking and content delivery network solutions.

What industries do you cater to?

We provide Cloud services to a wide range of industries, including Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, BFSI,
ITeS, Government-PSU and more.

How can a company prepare for cloud to cloud migration?

A company can prepare for cloud to cloud migration by performing a comprehensive inventory of its
current infrastructure, data, and applications, identifying potential compatibility issues or data
migration challenges, selecting a compatible cloud provider, and developing a migration plan that
includes testing and risk management measures

How can a company ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration?

A company can ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration by using encryption and secure
transfer protocols, implementing access controls and user authentication measures, and performing
regular security audits and risk assessments.

How can Orient Technologies Limited help us migrate our existing applications and data to the cloud?

Our team of experts can assist you with the planning, execution, and testing of your migration to
the cloud. We also offer automated tools and services to help you migrate your applications and data
quickly and efficiently.

What sets your cybersecurity solutions apart from competitors?

Full-spectrum Cybersecurity Solutions - From Cybersecurity Awareness, endpoint security to Cloud
Security and everything in between, Proactive threat intelligence, reducing vulnerabilities before
they escalate, Customizable security layers based on your unique business needs, Strategic
consulting through vCISO services, ensuring leadership-driven security frameworks, Cost-effective
scalability, offering enterprise-level security to businesses of all sizes.

What’s the ROI of investing in cybersecurity with Cyber Solutions?

Businesses that invest in proactive cybersecurity measures reduce breach costs by an average of 70%.

What industries benefit the most from your cybersecurity solutions?

Healthcare (PHI - protecting personal health information), Finance (Aligning with regulatory
compliances; safeguarding critical information assets), Retail & E-commerce (preventing data theft
and securing payment systems), Technology (safeguarding intellectual property), SMBs and enterprises
facing evolving digital threats.

How do your solutions ensure compliance with regulations like GDPR, HIPAA, or PCI DSS?

Our solutions are designed with compliance at their core. We offer frameworks and automated tools to
ensure your security practices align with industry regulations, minimizing risk and preventing
costly breaches.

How do you protect remote workforces and endpoints?

Through advanced Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) solutions, we secure devices across remote
environments.

How do I know which cybersecurity service is right for my business?

We offer a cyber risk assessment and an initial consultation to evaluate your current security
posture.

Can your solutions integrate with our existing security infrastructure?

Yes! Our services are designed to integrate seamlessly with your existing technology stack.

# Simplify your data center

Secure, flexible, and reliable open-source enterprise solutions.
For the highest demands and tight budgets in professional IT environments.

 

##### [NEW: Version 9.2][143]

## Proxmox
## Virtual Environment

Proxmox Virtual Environment is a complete open-source platform for enterprise virtualization. With
the built-in web interface you can easily manage VMs and containers, software-defined storage and
networking, high-availability clustering, and multiple out-of-the-box tools using a single solution.

[Learn more][144]

##### [NEW: Version 4.2][145]

## Proxmox
## Backup Server

Proxmox Backup Server is an enterprise backup solution for backing up and restoring VMs, containers,
and physical hosts. The open-source solution supports incremental backups, deduplication, Zstandard
compression, and authenticated encryption.

[Learn more][146]

##### [NEW: Version 1.1][147]

## Proxmox
## Datacenter Manager

Proxmox Datacenter Manager is a centralized open-source management solution for distributed
infrastructures. With its unified web interface you can easily monitor and control multiple Proxmox
remotes, see health and performance at a glance, and coordinate key operations across clusters and
data centers.

[Learn more][148]

Implementation

[Find a partner][150]


Training

Compact. Practical. Efficient. Quickly gain the know-how you need to operate your data center with
Proxmox solutions.

Docs

software.

success of Proxmox software. 


Success Stories

Community

Together with a strong, global community, we are continuously driving forward the development of the

# Preemptive exposure management

Whether you follow CTEM, Zero Trust, or your own framework, RedSeal’s AI-enabled exposure management
platform gives you the clarity and context to reduce risk faster — across
IT (on-prem, cloud, remote workers), OT, and IoT environments.

[ Schedule a Demo ][41]
[ LEARN MORE ABOUT CTEM ][42]

## Know your hybrid environment better than any adversary.

RedSeal delivers AI-enabled cyber terrain visibility and actionable insights to close security and
compliance gaps across your entire hybrid and remote environment. From hidden assets and
misconfigurations to exploitable attack paths, you’ll know exactly what matters most — and how to
address it.

### Hybrid Environment Modeling

Replace static diagrams and fragmented tools with a living, unified model of your entire environment
— complete, accurate, and continuously updated. See every asset, connection, and control, including
the ones other tools miss.

### Attack Path Analysis

Understand every possible way threats could move through your environment — before they strike.
Strengthen defenses and stop lateral movement by fixing exploitable gaps in advance.

### Risk Prioritization

Focus remediation where it reduces the most risk. RedSeal Risk Radius™ combines exploitability with
business impact to identify the exposures that truly matter — backed by transparent scoring, clear
evidence, and visual workflows that show why they’re prioritized.

### Continuous Compliance

Stay audit-ready every day, not just at audit time. RedSeal automatically validates your environment
against internal policies and standards like NIST, PCI DSS, CMMC, and CIS, with proof-ready reports.

RedSeal recognized in inaugural 2025 Gartner^{®} Magic Quadrant for Exposure Assessment Platforms

[ Download Now ][43]

Our AI-enabled exposure management platform, powered by its automated workflow engine, gives you
complete visibility into how threats can actually move through your hybrid environment, which
exposures matter most to your business, and proof that your controls are working as intended.

# Preemptive exposure management

Whether you follow CTEM, Zero Trust, or your own framework, RedSeal’s AI-enabled exposure management
platform gives you the clarity and context to reduce risk faster — across
IT (on-prem, cloud, remote workers), OT, and IoT environments.

[ Schedule a Demo ][41]
[ LEARN MORE ABOUT CTEM ][42]

## Know your hybrid environment better than any adversary.

RedSeal delivers AI-enabled cyber terrain visibility and actionable insights to close security and
compliance gaps across your entire hybrid and remote environment. From hidden assets and
misconfigurations to exploitable attack paths, you’ll know exactly what matters most — and how to
address it.

### Hybrid Environment Modeling

Replace static diagrams and fragmented tools with a living, unified model of your entire environment
— complete, accurate, and continuously updated. See every asset, connection, and control, including
the ones other tools miss.

### Attack Path Analysis

Understand every possible way threats could move through your environment — before they strike.
Strengthen defenses and stop lateral movement by fixing exploitable gaps in advance.

### Risk Prioritization

Focus remediation where it reduces the most risk. RedSeal Risk Radius™ combines exploitability with
business impact to identify the exposures that truly matter — backed by transparent scoring, clear
evidence, and visual workflows that show why they’re prioritized.

### Continuous Compliance

Stay audit-ready every day, not just at audit time. RedSeal automatically validates your environment
against internal policies and standards like NIST, PCI DSS, CMMC, and CIS, with proof-ready reports.

RedSeal recognized in inaugural 2025 Gartner^{®} Magic Quadrant for Exposure Assessment Platforms

## Rethinking Your
## *Cybersecurity*

Security isn't static — neither are we. RSI Security pairs AI-powered automation with human-led
expertise to simplify compliance, strengthen defenses, and protect what matters most. Across SOC 2,
HIPAA, PCI DSS, CMMC, and NIST, we harmonize overlapping frameworks into one strategy that scales
with your business.

But our work doesn't end at the assessment. Compliance is a moving target — frameworks evolve,
threats shift, and your environment never stops changing. That's why we stay with you beyond the
audit: a partner invested in your security posture for the long run, not a vendor you only hear from

## Rethinking Your
## *Cybersecurity*

Security isn't static — neither are we. RSI Security pairs AI-powered automation with human-led
expertise to simplify compliance, strengthen defenses, and protect what matters most. Across SOC 2,
HIPAA, PCI DSS, CMMC, and NIST, we harmonize overlapping frameworks into one strategy that scales
with your business.

But our work doesn't end at the assessment. Compliance is a moving target — frameworks evolve,
threats shift, and your environment never stops changing. That's why we stay with you beyond the
audit: a partner invested in your security posture for the long run, not a vendor you only hear from
at renewal.

## Decision Over Chaos

Embracing Agentic AI

Security teams are drowning in alerts while attackers move faster than ever. Securonix Unified
Defense SIEM uses an Agentic Mesh of specialized AI agents to help teams decide and act across the
threat lifecycle with speed, context, and control.
* Unified detection and response across data sources
* AI-driven anomaly detection with context
* Pre-built content and playbooks

**
The Result:** Security teams improve response times by up to 60 percent.


[SEE HOW][162]

## Alerts to Action

Evolving to the Agentic SOC

Traditional SIEMs generate volume. Modern security demands outcomes. As threats grow more complex,
teams need systems that reason, prioritize, and guide response in real time.

Powered by an Agentic Mesh, Securonix coordinates AI agents across detection, investigation, and
response to turn signals into guided decisions with human oversight.

With Securonix:
* Reduce alert noise and surface validated risk
* Accelerate investigations with contextual guidance
* Strengthen breach readiness across the environment
* Elevate SOC Analysts from Level 1 to Level 2

[SEE HOW][163]

## Productivity Instead of Noise

The AI SOC Analyst

Sam, the AI SOC Analyst, operates across the Unified Defense platform, analyzing behavior,
understanding context, and recommending actions across detection, investigation, and response.
Always learning. Always accountable. Always human-guided.

With Sam:
* Automated alert triage and prioritization
* Contextual enrichment using identity, behavior, and threat intelligence
* Investigation summaries that eliminate manual pivoting
* Case preparation for escalation and response
* Executive- and board-ready security summaries


[MEET SAM][164]

## Unified Defense SIEM’s Powerful Features

Securonix unifies analytics, threat intelligence, investigation, and response into a single
cloud-native platform designed for scale, precision, and speed. The Agentic Mesh orchestrates these
capabilities as one coordinated system.

## Threat Intelligence That Drives Action

Threat intelligence only matters when it improves decisions. Securonix transforms intelligence into
operational context by enriching detections, prioritizing risk, and guiding response across your
environment.
* Native intelligence ingestion and enrichment
* MITRE ATT&CK aligned context
* Integrated ThreatQ capabilities

[LEARN MORE][165]

## Less reporting. More investigation.

ThreatQ, now part of Securonix, brings curated threat intelligence into the Securonix security
operations portfolio. It centralizes, enriches, and prioritizes intelligence from internal and
external sources so teams can improve detection quality, accelerate investigations, and respond with
stronger context.

With ThreatQ, teams can:
* Unify threat intelligence across SOC, CTI, and IR workflows
* Enrich and prioritize indicators with relevant context
* Operationalize intelligence across SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, and firewalls
* Strengthen Securonix AI-driven detection and response


[SEE HOW][166]

## Trusted by Global Security Leaders

Evolving to the Agentic SOC

Enterprises and MSSPs rely on Securonix to modernize security operations, reduce operational risk,
and move from reactive response to proactive, intelligence-driven defense. And there’s a reason for
that:

**Six-Time Consecutive Leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for SIEM**
Consistently recognized for completeness of vision and ability to execute, reflecting sustained
innovation, architectural strength, and customer trust.

**Two-Time Customers’ Choice on Gartner Peer Insights™**
Validated directly by security practitioners for product capabilities, deployment experience, and
measurable operational value.

Together, these recognitions reflect both strategic leadership and real-world impact for Enterprises
and MSSPs.

Defense SIEM uses an Agentic Mesh of specialized AI agents to help teams decide and act across the
threat lifecycle with speed, context, and control.
* Unified detection and response across data sources
* AI-driven anomaly detection with context
* Pre-built content and playbooks

**
The Result:** Security teams improve response times by up to 60 percent.

Evolving to the Agentic SOC

Traditional SIEMs generate volume. Modern security demands outcomes. As threats grow more complex,
teams need systems that reason, prioritize, and guide response in real time.

Powered by an Agentic Mesh, Securonix coordinates AI agents across detection, investigation, and
response to turn signals into guided decisions with human oversight.

With Securonix:
* Reduce alert noise and surface validated risk
* Accelerate investigations with contextual guidance
* Strengthen breach readiness across the environment
* Elevate SOC Analysts from Level 1 to Level 2

[SEE HOW][163]

## Productivity Instead of Noise

The AI SOC Analyst

Sam, the AI SOC Analyst, operates across the Unified Defense platform, analyzing behavior,
understanding context, and recommending actions across detection, investigation, and response.
Always learning. Always accountable. Always human-guided.

With Sam:
* Automated alert triage and prioritization
* Contextual enrichment using identity, behavior, and threat intelligence
* Investigation summaries that eliminate manual pivoting
* Case preparation for escalation and response
* Executive- and board-ready security summaries


[MEET SAM][164]

## Unified Defense SIEM’s Powerful Features

Securonix unifies analytics, threat intelligence, investigation, and response into a single
cloud-native platform designed for scale, precision, and speed. The Agentic Mesh orchestrates these
capabilities as one coordinated system.

## Threat Intelligence That Drives Action

Threat intelligence only matters when it improves decisions. Securonix transforms intelligence into
operational context by enriching detections, prioritizing risk, and guiding response across your
environment.
* Native intelligence ingestion and enrichment
* MITRE ATT&CK aligned context
* Integrated ThreatQ capabilities

[LEARN MORE][165]

## Less reporting. More investigation.

ThreatQ, now part of Securonix, brings curated threat intelligence into the Securonix security
operations portfolio. It centralizes, enriches, and prioritizes intelligence from internal and
external sources so teams can improve detection quality, accelerate investigations, and respond with
stronger context.

With ThreatQ, teams can:
* Unify threat intelligence across SOC, CTI, and IR workflows
* Enrich and prioritize indicators with relevant context
* Operationalize intelligence across SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, and firewalls
* Strengthen Securonix AI-driven detection and response

Respecting your privacy has always been among Xiaomi's core values.Our data protection practice is
conforming to top standards around the world.Lei JunFounder, Chairman, CEO

## Statement

## Transparency is our policy

It is important that our users know what information we collect and why, and how it’s used. Being
explicitly clear about our data practice by making the information accessible and understandable, we
help you make informed decisions as you use our products and services.We also publicly publish our
Transparency Report
.

## Control of your data

At Xiaomi, we believe users should stay informed and in control when it comes to privacy. The
control over your data always remains an individual choice that belongs only to you. We will only
collect your data with your consent. You can request to access, correct or delete the information
collected in
Privacy Support
at any time.

## Keep your data secure

Your data is secured by our security protection mechanisms which are tested and certified by the
world's leading experts. Your data is transmitted by the encrypted communication channels and stored
in global top-tier cloud providers.

## Supporting global privacy compliance

Privacy and security protection have always been the key concepts of our product design. We devote
ourselves to establishing a standardized, and progressive privacy impact assessment procedure to
ensure that our products and services are compliant with data protection laws and regulations.

## Innovating trustworthy AI

We believe that AI technology enhances and enriches user experience of our consumer electronic
products. We are currently using AI algorithms in four areas of application in our devices: camera
image optimization, voice communication noise reduction, fingerprint and face unlocking. Our AI
algorithms never transmit any user data. All AI algorithms in these four areas of application run on
your local device, and all data processed by these AI algorithms is stored on your local device
only.

## No data will be uploaded under Mi Browser incognito mode

Mi Browser is a chromium-based web browser. We won't record the sites you visit, the keywords your
searched and any other data when the incognito mode is enabled.

## * We store user data in top-tier cloud providers, including Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, etc.

## Building Trust

## We begin with the following four principles

## SECURITY

## We are committed to creating a more secure digital world.

## PRIVACY

## We respect and protect your privacy.

## COMPLIANCE

## We fully comply with applicable laws and regulations.

## TRANSPARENCY

## We strive for transparency regarding requests of the authorities.

# Structured Unit4 Delivery Built for Control and Continuity

Vision ERP is a specialist Unit4 partner delivering structured implementation, cloud migration, and
managed ERP services.

We support public sector and service-led organisations with governance-led transformation focused on
control, continuity, and measurable outcomes.

[Speak to a Specialist ][2]
[Structured Unit4 Delivery Built for Control and Continuity][background image]
[Specialist Unit4 Services]

## Specialist Unit4 Services

We provide structured, end-to-end support across the Unit4 lifecycle, from implementation and cloud
transition to ongoing optimisation and governance.

## Why Choose Us

At Vision ERP, we offer more than just solutions; we offer a transformative partnership.

[Expertise in many industries]

### Expertise in many industries

With extensive experience working with varied industries from government agencies and public
organisations to Not for Profit, Higher Education and Professional Services, we have an in-depth
understanding of the regulatory, compliance, and transparency requirements.

[Tailored Solutions]

### Tailored Solutions

We customise our solutions to align perfectly with the unique needs of your business, ensuring that
you get the right tools for success.

[Proven Success]

### Proven Success

Our track record includes successful projects that have significantly improved efficiency, reduced
costs, and enhanced transparency.

[Data Security and Compliance]

### Data Security and Compliance

We prioritise data security and compliance with stringent measures to protect sensitive information
and ensure adherence to regulatory requirements, safeguarding the integrity and confidentiality of
data.

[Robust Support and Training]

### Robust Support and Training

We offer comprehensive support and training programs to ensure your team is well-equipped to
leverage our solutions effectively. We are committed to your long-term success.

[Scalability and Future-Readiness]

### Scalability and Future-Readiness

Our solutions are designed to grow with your organisation. As your needs evolve, our systems can
adapt, ensuring that you're prepared for future challenges and opportunities.

[Cost-Efficiency]

### Cost-Efficiency

We understand the budget constraints within industries such as public sector and Higher Education.
Our solutions are designed to deliver cost-efficiency, helping organisations achieve more with their
available resources.

[Maximise Impact with Our Unit4 Solutions]

## Maximise Impact with Our Unit4 Solutions

In today’s modern organisations, efficiency, cost control and transparency are essential—whether
services are centralised, shared or delivered locally.

Vision ERP’s Unit4 solutions provide the visibility and integration needed to streamline operations,
remove data silos and enable collaboration across the organisation.

[Read More ][3]

## What We Offer

As organisations adapt to constant change, Vision ERP stands alongside you as a partner focused on
operational excellence and long-term success.

[Unit4 ERP]

## Unit4 ERP

Unit4 ERP is your key to efficient and transparent operations in your organisation. Our
comprehensive implementation and consultancy services ensure that you leverage the full potential of
Unit4 ERP.

We integrate your financial, HR, supply chain, and project management functions, providing total
visibility and enhancing transparency in your operations. With our ongoing management support, you
can adapt to changing requirements, optimise performance, and achieve greater efficiency.

[Read More ][4]
[Unit4 FP&A]

## Unit4 FP&A

Unit4 FP&A underpins effective financial planning and analysis across modern organisations. Vision
ERP provides end-to-end implementation and consultancy services to ensure you fully leverage the
platform’s capabilities.

Real-time insight and cross-functional collaboration support informed decision-making, robust
budgeting and forward-looking financial plans. Ongoing support helps organisations adapt quickly and
maintain control in an ever-changing environment.

[Read More ][5]
[Unit4 Talent Management]

## Unit4 Talent Management

Building and nurturing high-performing workforces is essential in all businesses. Unit4 Talent
Management provides you with the tools to attract, develop, and retain top talent.

We help you create a culture of continuous learning, enhance individual and team performance, and
maximise efficiency. Our ongoing management support ensures that your workforce remains motivated,
engaged, and equipped to meet the ever-evolving demands of your community.

[Read more ][6]

## Our Customers

## Frequently Asked Questions

How is computing investment different from crypto mining?

Computing investment is about renting computing power for real-world use cases like AI training and
scientific computing. Revenue comes from enterprise clients' leasing fees. This is fundamentally
different from crypto mining — our revenue model is based on real commercial demand and long-term
contracts, not token price fluctuations.

What is the minimum investment threshold?

We offer tiered plans starting from ¥99,000 for the Starter. The Pro plan suits high-net-worth
clients, while the Enterprise plan is customized to your specific needs. All plans provide
transparent return expectations and risk disclosures.

How is my computing asset secured?

All computing equipment is deployed in our T3+ certified data center with 24/7 security, fire
suppression, and climate control systems. We also provide asset insurance, real-time monitoring
dashboards, and regular audit reports. Contracts clearly define asset ownership to ensure your
rights are legally protected.

How are returns calculated and distributed?

Returns are calculated based on the actual rental of your hosted computing resources, accumulated
daily and settled monthly. You can monitor utilization rates, revenue details, and settlement
progress in real-time through your dedicated dashboard. We offer bank transfers, USDT, and other
settlement methods.

Can I visit the data center in person?

of our super factory firsthand. Professional plan and above customers enjoy complimentary quarterly
visits. Starter plan customers can schedule paid visits. Please contact your account manager in

FAQ

## Frequently Asked Questions

How is computing investment different from crypto mining?

Computing investment is about renting computing power for real-world use cases like AI training and
scientific computing. Revenue comes from enterprise clients' leasing fees. This is fundamentally
different from crypto mining — our revenue model is based on real commercial demand and long-term
contracts, not token price fluctuations.

What is the minimum investment threshold?

We offer tiered plans starting from ¥99,000 for the Starter. The Pro plan suits high-net-worth
clients, while the Enterprise plan is customized to your specific needs. All plans provide
transparent return expectations and risk disclosures.

How is my computing asset secured?

All computing equipment is deployed in our T3+ certified data center with 24/7 security, fire
suppression, and climate control systems. We also provide asset insurance, real-time monitoring
dashboards, and regular audit reports. Contracts clearly define asset ownership to ensure your
rights are legally protected.

How are returns calculated and distributed?

Returns are calculated based on the actual rental of your hosted computing resources, accumulated
daily and settled monthly. You can monitor utilization rates, revenue details, and settlement
progress in real-time through your dedicated dashboard. We offer bank transfers, USDT, and other
settlement methods.

Can I visit the data center in person?

Absolutely. We organize regular customer tours where you can see the scale and operational standards
of our super factory firsthand. Professional plan and above customers enjoy complimentary quarterly
visits. Starter plan customers can schedule paid visits. Please contact your account manager in
advance to arrange your trip.

containment, physical security, and high availability.

The cybersecurity platform for the AI Age - built on Zero Trust to protect users, workloads,
branches and devices through the world’s largest inline security cloud.

Embrace AI with confidence using Zscaler AI Protect, a unified solution to secure AI at scale.

Draw on insights from the world’s largest inline security cloud and third-party sources to assess
risk and detect and contain breaches.

Phishing is getting quieter and more dangerous. Although volume is down ~20% YoY, AI is accelerating
targeted lures and initial access.

attack surfaces, validating stolen credentials, and executing account takeover inside encrypted
traffic.
